notes: A USING file in the open mode at the start of the MERGE: "the EC-SORT-MERGE-FILE-OPEN exception condition is set to exist and the execution of the MERGE statement terminates" (§2002:14.8.23.3 GR7; cite.py --check). EC-SORT-MERGE-FILE-OPEN is Fatal (§2002 Table 14), so §2002:14.5.12.1.2 decides the run unit: with checking enabled the declarative runs and "If execution of the declarative completes normally the execution of the run unit is terminated abnormally" (item 2). There is no 2002 item for a MERGE or SORT statement (§2023:14.6.13.1.3 2) is new in 2023), so at --std 2002 the MERGE guard does not hand the marked condition to the verb: DialectBehavior.SortMergeStatementDisposesItsFatalConditions (VCR row 7.80, kb/Work PB5612). The golden prints the declarative and ends the run unit.
